post_text:
Day 7/30 — PeriodicTimer vs System.Threading.Timer (.NET & C#)

Old-school timers invite thread pool starvation and unhandled async void exceptions during long-running queue polls.

• **Async Safety:** WaitForNextTickAsync allows proper task continuation without void delegates.
• **Reentrancy Control:** Prevents overlapping execution ticks if work takes longer than the interval.
• **Resource Cleanup:** Implements IAsyncDisposable for deterministic background lifecycle management.

Watch out: Disposing the timer mid-tick cancels the active wait token.

Are you still using callback timers?
